candidate.title: Nuc-Seq
candidate.scope: The single Nuc-Seq route in the assigned Illumina schematic, interpreted as the frozen-tissue, modified Smart-seq2/Nextera XT implementation associated with Krishnaswami et al. (2016). The matching collection page is headed Nuc-Seq: A Single-Nucleus RNA-Seq from Frozen Tissues and captions this image as an overview of Nuc-seq. The far-left Single cell/poly(A) RNA inset illustrates the RNA-sequencing concept; it has no material-transfer arrow to the Tissue workflow and does not define another target. Smart-seq2 and Nextera XT are components. snRNA-seq and Div-Seq are catalogue-listed similar methods, not depicted alternatives. The drawn sequence ends at the indexed enrichment-ready DNA fragment; sequencing and expression interpretation describe its readout without adding unshown graph operations. Fixation and centrifugation are qualified explicitly in corrections rather than silently equated with the primary protocol.

operations.label: cDNA synthesis
operations.description: Convert accessible poly(A) nuclear RNA into primer-tagged cDNA using the depicted poly(A)/oligo-dT and GGG/CCC interfaces. The LNA label is resolved by the primary material list as the G-rich template-switch oligonucleotide.
operations.mechanism: Modified Smart-seq2: oligo-dT priming and template switching favor full-length cDNA. operations.information_effect: Transfers RNA sequence information into an amplifiable DNA carrier. Poly(A) priming selects the represented RNA fraction; successful template switching does not guarantee every cDNA is full length.

method_scopes.rationale: All main-route operations belong to the sole Nuc-Seq schematic target. The assigned LNA/Smart-seq2 and Nextera XT route is consistent with the cited 2016 protocol; it is a supported implementation within the broader nuclear RNA-sequencing family. It does not establish identical preparation for all single-nucleus methods. o1 is explicitly interpreted from the primary frozen-tissue protocol without chemical fixation (c1); o2 retains drawn centrifugation while qualifying its optional status in that protocol (c2). o4 supplies the paper-supported compartment-release interface that the image leaves unlabeled. The single-cell/RNA inset is descriptive, and the two Tn5 icons share one substrate. No alternative workflow or independent branch is depicted.
